advancements.fossil_finder_owl.a_friend_: Earn the trust of a Fossil Finder Owl.
advancements.fossil_finder_owl.field_tri: Give your owl Field Notes and start an expedition.
advancements.fossil_finder_owl.the_littl: Give your owl a Museum Guide and return to museum mode.
advancements.fossil_finder_owl.digging_u: Let your owl uncover its first fossil.
advancements.fossil_finder_owl.a_snack_f: Help your owl feel better with a tasty snack.
advancements.fossil_finder_owl.a_dapper_: Give your owl one of its very own hats.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.museum.1: Every specimen has a story. I do love a good story.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.museum.2: A quiet day among the fossils is a lovely day indeed.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.museum.3: I wonder what fascinating creature left that fossil behind.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.museum.4: Do be careful with the exhibits. They are much older than I am!
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.fieldwork.1: Field notes ready! I have a good feeling about this dig.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.fieldwork.2: The ground is full of stories waiting to be uncovered.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.fieldwork.3: I shall keep my eyes peeled for a fossil!
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.fieldwork.4: A little fresh air and paleontology. What could be better?
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.tamed.1: Oh! You would like me to join your expedition? How exciting!
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.tamed.2: A friend, and a field partner! I am quite delighted.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.feeding.1: How thoughtful! That was simply delicious.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.feeding.2: A snack from a friend is the best kind of snack.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.mode.1: Splendid! I am ready for a change of pace.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.mode.2: A new chapter in our adventure begins!
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.mining.1: Look what I found! The past is full of surprises.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.mining.2: A fossil! I knew there was something interesting here.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.mining.3: Another piece of prehistory for our collection!
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.hat.1: Oh, this hat suits me rather well, don't you think?
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.hat.2: A hat of my own! I feel ready for any expedition.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.alert.1: Look out! Something dangerous is nearby!
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.alert.2: I say, let's give that unfriendly creature some room.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.pickaxe: Excellent tool! I shall treat it with the utmost care.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.pickaxe_rejec: I'm afraid that pickaxe is too flimsy for fossil work.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.light: A lantern! Now I can see every little detail.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.follow.1: Right behind you! Lead the way.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.follow.2: An expedition is always better with a friend.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.stay.1: I'll keep watch from right here.
dialogue.fossil_finder_owl.stay.2: Very well. I'll save my energy for when you return.
